SAPNA SHARMA AVP- AGILE PRODUCT OWNER sapnasharma711@gmail.com | 7428136637| Pune, India

CAREER O B J ECTI VE Senior Product Owner/Business Analyst with 1 2+ years of experience delivering Agile product, data and regulatory transformation initiatives across Banking, Capital Markets, Fixed Income Reference Data and Risk domains. Strong expertise in stakeholder management, requirements engineering, SQL-based data analysis, data governance, data quality, testing, delivery management and AI-enabled productivity solutions.

SKI LLS/ TO O LS • Product Skills: Stakeholder Engagement, End-to-end requirements gathering, Backlog Creation & Prioritization, Epics &

User Stories, Sprint Planning, Agile Delivery, UAT/SIT Planning and Testing, Impact & Gap Analysis, Acceptance criteria

Domain Skills: Fixed Income Reference Data, Capital Market, Credit Risk, Client Onboarding, KYC Controls, Data Governance, Data Quality & Lineage (BCBS239), Understanding of Payment lifecycle and Payment Industry

Data & Technical Skills: SQL, PL/SQL, API Integration (functional), Data Analysis, Data Validation, Data Mapping, Data modelling, Reporting & Analytics, Root Cause Analysis, Understanding of Event-Driven Architecture/ MQ / Kafka, Correlation ID Tracing, Cloud Fundamentals (GCP), JSON / XML payload review AI & Emerging Technologies: Generative AI (GenAI), Prompt Engineering, AI-Assisted Requirements Analysis, User Story Generation, Test Case Generation, Documentation Automation, Knowledge Management, Process Optimization, Workflow Automation, AI-Assisted Data Analysis, Business Process Transformation Tools: MS Office, Advanced Excel, Power BI (familiarity), PLSQL, Hue, Dbeaver, Tectia, BareGrep, Jira, Confluence, Gemini Code assist, Microsoft Copilot, Github copilot





WO RK EXPERI EN CE AVP – Agile Product Owner Deutsche Bank Pvt Ltd

Sept 2023 - present

Act as Lead Business Analyst and SME for enterprise platforms supporting client onboarding application alignment with credit risk applications, risk controls, and data governance initiatives.

Gathered, analyzed, and documented business and functional and non-functional requirements (BRD/FRD) by partnering with Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Product stakeholders.

Owned end-to-end delivery of multiple workstreams including scope definition, milestones, dependency management, and execution within committed timelines.

Perform data analysis, validation and issue investigations using SQL and enterprise datasets. • Collaborated with business and technology teams to define requirements for API-based integrations, data exchange workflows, and cloud-based applications, ensuring seamless data flow across enterprise platforms. Lead SIT/UAT planning, defect triage, production support, risk management and governance activities.

• Reviewed and validated structured message payloads (JSON/XML) during SIT/UAT cycles, ensuring field-level accuracy across system interfaces and flagging mapping discrepancies in coordination with Solution Architects and component teams. Leveraged Generative AI tools (Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini) to accelerate requirements engineering, impact analysis, documentation, test case generation, process optimization, and knowledge management activities, improving delivery efficiency and team productivity.



ENO – Business Analyst Credit Suisse •

Mar 2021 – Sept 2023

Led requirements gathering, impact analysis, BRD/FRD documentation and workflow analysis.

• Translated business needs into system specifications, user stories and testing requirements. • Supported Agile SDLC, SIT/UAT, regression testing and governance reporting. • Collaborated with global stakeholders and managed dependencies and issue resolution.

Sr Analyst 1 – Fixed Income Reference data IHS Markit (now S&P Global Inc) • Defined business requirements and translated complex workflows into automation opportunities. • Managed data quality, feed mapping, data lineage and fixed-income reference datasets. • Supported fixed income reference data processes utilized by investment banking and asset servicing stakeholders. • Supported reporting needs and executive dashboards using trusted data sources. • Partnered with Product Owners and Scrum teams to prioritize enhancements and delivery outcomes.

Apr 201 5 - Mar 2021

Process Analyst Broadridge Financial Solution • Supported trade settlement operations, process improvements, operational risk mitigation and SLA adherence. • Contributed to process improvement initiatives, trained team members on DTCC, ADP BPS, and Questrade Arrow, and

Jan 201 4 – Apr 201 5

supported operational excellence.

ACH I EVEM E N TS • Substantial contribution in ongoing projects that led our team being awarded the best team for quarter ended 201 7

Received an award in 201 6 for outstanding performance and contribution. • Made successful transition of process from Hyderabad to Delhi • Appreciated for closing critical audit point with one of the legacy feed migrations rBroadidge

Deutsche Bank

CE RTI FI CATES • CFA Level 1 cleared (06/201 7 – present) • Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I) – Scrum.org (2025) • Generative AI fundamentals – Google cloud

ED U CATI O N • MBA- Finance | Manonmaniam Sundaranar University|201 0-201 2 • BE – E&C | Rajasthan University |2005-2009
